standard_prerequisites.use: Every ordinal is zero, a successor, or a limit, so a least counterexample must fall in one of the three hypotheses.

core_obligations: Contrapositive setup (proof lines 945-946): assume some ordinal falsifies phi and take the least such gamma.

Case division (lines 946-951): gamma is empty, a successor of some alpha with phi(alpha), or a limit with phi at all beta in gamma; each disjunct contradicts the respective hypothesis (1), (2), (3) of the statement.
proof_roadmap: Assume a counterexample and take the least one.
Run through the three possible shapes of an ordinal.
Match each shape against the corresponding closure hypothesis.
